element: Consideration failed - the promised value was not delivered
element_source: SRC-021 P117 (pleading's own recital) - UNRESEARCHED - taken from the pleading's own 'Elements' recital at SRC-021 and NOT independently verified against controlling authority. Route to legal-research-paralegal before relying on this element list.
pleaded_facts_summary: Only $51,409.50 appeared in Plaintiff's Bank of America account on 08/05/2022 against a $149,650.00 face amount
strongest_attack: This is a DEBT CONSOLIDATION HELOC. SRC-023 states Lendage's product pays creditors directly, and SRC-021 P18 itself calls the $51,409.50 a cash-out consistent with a $50,000 cap. Proceeds paid to third-party creditors are still consideration. Defendants will say the remaining ~$98,000 went to payoffs and produce the disbursement schedule.
notes: STRATEGICALLY THE MOST IMPORTANT ROW IN THIS MATRIX. This count avoids the Ames standing bar entirely because it attacks the obligation, not the assignment - and Judge Bagley already identified proceeds delivery as the question many claims turn on (SRC-010 Doc. 34 at 7). But it lives or dies on GAP-001, and the innocent explanation is strong. Do not plead it as though the gap were already closed.

notes: Curable by limiting Count IX to MEB. Leaving it invites a clean partial dismissal that costs credibility on the count's stronger half.
